name: ballerinax/gcloud.pubsub
description: Google Cloud Pub/Sub is an asynchronous messaging service that decouples services that produce events from services that process events. It provides highly reliable and scalable event distribution for modern cloud applications. The GCloud PubSub connector enables seamless integration with Google Cloud Pub/Sub, allowing you to build reactive and event-driven systems.

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: Represents Google Cloud Pub/Sub module related errors.

typeDefs.name: Credentials
typeDefs.description: Represents credentials for authenticating with Google Cloud Pub/Sub.

fields.name: credentialsPath
fields.description: Path to the service account JSON key file

fields.name: credentialsJson
fields.description: Service account JSON key as a string

typeDefs.name: BatchSettings
typeDefs.description: Represents batch settings for the publisher.

fields.name: elementCountThreshold
fields.description: Maximum number of messages in a batch (default: 100)

fields.name: requestByteSizeThreshold
fields.description: Maximum size of a batch in bytes (default: 1000000)

fields.name: delayThresholdMillis
fields.description: Maximum delay before sending a batch in milliseconds (default: 10)

typeDefs.name: PublisherConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Represents configuration for the Google Cloud Pub/Sub publisher.

fields.name: enableBatching
fields.description: When enabled, the publisher will batch messages before sending

fields.name: enableMessageOrdering
fields.description: When enabled, the publisher will publish messages with ordering keys

typeDefs.name: ListenerConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Represents configuration for the Google Cloud Pub/Sub listener.

typeDefs.name: Message
typeDefs.description: Represents a message to be published to Google Cloud Pub/Sub.

fields.name: messageId
fields.description: Unique message identifier (Set by the broker upon publishing. Do not set manually)

fields.name: publishTime
fields.description: Time when the message was published (Set by the broker upon publishing. Do not set manually)

fields.name: orderingKey
fields.description:
Ordering key for ordered delivery. Messages with the same ordering key are delivered in order.
`enableMessageOrdering` must be set to true in publisher configuration to use this feature

typeDefs.name: Listener
typeDefs.description:
Initializes a Listener object with the given subscription and configuration.
```ballerina
pubsub:Listener pubsubListener = check new("my-subscription", projectId = "my-project");
```

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initializes a Listener object with the given subscription and configuration.
```ballerina
pubsub:Listener pubsubListener = check new("my-subscription", projectId = "my-project");
```

parameters.name: subscriptionName
parameters.description: The subscription name or full path

functions.name: attach
functions.description:
Attaches the service to the `pubsub:Listener` endpoint.
```ballerina
check pubsubListener.attach(service);
```

return.description: `()` or else a `pubsub:Error` upon failure to register the service

functions.name: 'start
functions.description:
Starts consuming messages on the attached service.
```ballerina
check pubsubListener.'start();
```

functions.name: detach
functions.description:
Detaches a service from the `pubsub:Listener` endpoint.
```ballerina
check pubsubListener.detach(service);
```

return.description: `()` or else a `pubsub:Error` upon failure to detach the service

functions.name: gracefulStop
functions.description:
Stops consuming messages and gracefully shuts down the subscriber.
```ballerina
check pubsubListener.gracefulStop();
```

functions.name: immediateStop
functions.description:
Immediately stops consuming messages and terminates the subscriber.
```ballerina
check pubsubListener.immediateStop();
```

clients.name: Caller
clients.description: Provides functionality to acknowledge or reject messages received by the listener service.

functions.name: ack
functions.description:
Acknowledges the received message.
```ballerina
check caller->ack();
```

return.description: A `pubsub:Error` if acknowledgement fails or else '()'

functions.name: nack
functions.description:
Rejects the received message and requests re-delivery.
```ballerina
check caller->nack();
```

return.description: A `pubsub:Error` if operation fails or else '()'

clients.name: Publisher
clients.description: Represents a Google Cloud Pub/Sub publisher endpoint.

parameters.name: topicName
parameters.description: The name of the topic to publish to (format: projects/{project-id}/topics/{topic-name})

parameters.name: enableBatching
parameters.description: When enabled, the publisher will batch messages before sending

parameters.name: enableMessageOrdering
parameters.description: When enabled, the publisher will publish messages with ordering keys

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Configurations related to initializing the publisher

return.description: A `gcloud.pubsub:Error` if initialization fails or else '()'

functions.name: publish
functions.description:
Publishes a message to the topic.
```ballerina
string|gcloud.pubsub:Error? result = publisher->publish({data: "Hello World".toBytes()});
```

return.description: The message ID as a string or a `gcloud.pubsub:Error` if the publish operation fails

functions.name: publishBatch
functions.description:
Publishes multiple messages to the topic.
```ballerina
string[]|gcloud.pubsub:Error? result = publisher->publishBatch([{data: "Message 1".toBytes()}, {data: "Message 2".toBytes()}]);
```

parameters.name: messages
parameters.description: Array of messages to be published

return.description: The message IDs as an array of strings or a `gcloud.pubsub:Error` if the publish operation fails

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Closes the publisher and releases all resources.
```ballerina
gcloud.pubsub:Error? result = publisher->close();
```

return.description: A `gcloud.pubsub:Error` if closing the publisher fails or else '()'
